# Intro {#sec-intro}

```{r}
x <- 7
y <- c(1.23, 4.56, 7.89)
```

Title is {{< meta title >}}. The value x is `r x` and the rounded mean is `r round(mean(y), 1)`.
See @fig-one, @tbl-one and the foo section. Also intro.

```{r}
#| label: fig-one
#| fig-cap: "A plot of y"
#| echo: false
plot(y)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: "A table of y"
knitr::kable(data.frame(y = y))
```

Back to intro. End: `r x * 2`.
